title: Review of c45's Marangoni ladder on fresh seed 102: kinds breed true (every kind change of a living rod at a logged mutation, 4/100 off-kind daughters) and the kind sets swim speed (path speed 0.148/0.228/0.289 for mar 20/40/60), which the identical-event twin lacks (0.213/0.186/0.227)
summary: Re-ran the ladder world (three surfactant kinds, mar 20/40/60, majority-feedback copying, neighbour mutation, p 0.10 + REDIST turnover) and its identical-event twin (MARS [40,40,40]) on seed 102 (128^2, 400 frames, T=2000), then c00's extract.py and the author's ladder_stats.py (runs/*/stats.txt; the script's last line, which writes a copy to the author's /tmp, fails after printing everything). Ladder: 7 mutation events, 6 kind changes along tracks, all 6 at a logged mutation of that body; 4 of 100 daughters off-kind; dividing rods by kind k0/k1/k2: n 13/12/18, median D 1.10/1.75/1.54 rod lengths, path speed 0.148/0.228/0.289, share D >= 3 0.08/0/0.17. Twin: 8 kind changes, all at mutations, 4/100 off-kind daughters; n 24/11/5, median D 1.08/1.07/1.07, path speed 0.213/0.186/0.227.

observations.H: runs/ladder_s102/stats.txt: 6/6 kind changes of living rods at logged mutations, 4/100 off-kind daughters; runs/ladder_s102/sheet.png t=520-2000 shows pink, yellow and green kinds kept through divisions; path speed rises with kind 0.148/0.228/0.289 while the twin (runs/twin_s102/stats.txt) is flat 0.213/0.186/0.227 and its median D is 1.07 in every kind

controls_run.H: runs/twin_s102 (MARS [40,40,40], same seed, same mutation and dilution streams)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed with 12-18 dividing rods per kind, so the distance effect (median D 1.10 vs 1.54 for k0 vs k2, but k1 highest at 1.75) is not tested statistically here; the speed ordering is clean. The kind is a copied label whose mar is a written parameter; heredity rests on the majority-feedback copying, which the twin also shows (4/100 off-kind), so the kind itself breeds true independently of its effect.
